lifetime.observed_gameplay_law: Once acquired, super jump remains active for the rest of Flik's time in the current level. It ends only when the level ends, Flik exits the stage, or a game over ends that level session.
lifetime.ordinary_jump: The bit is sampled on every vertical update and is not consumed by jumping.
lifetime.ordinary_checkpoint_update: 0x80054CB4 clears only 0x08 and 0x80054E90 sets only 0x08; both preserve 0x20.
lifetime.resident_transition_masks: 0x8004A94C and 0x80048C14 retain 0x20 in their local masks; these local stores are not the whole stage-exit reset mechanism.
lifetime.respawn_transition_normalizer: 0x8005B330..0x8005B340 retains only 0x20, explicitly preserving super jump while clearing sibling transient flags.
lifetime.static_overwrite_caveat: 0x8004867C and 0x800486BC can overwrite player+0x90 in the generic action-lockout code, but static presence does not prove that either path is reachable after acquisition. The prior claim that cannon or knockdown cancels an obtained super jump is retracted.
lifetime.save_state: The accepted state-anchored capsule reproduced exactly against its independent control; an emulator save state preserves full machine state by construction.
lifetime.level_boundary: Observed behavior places reset at level end, stage exit, or game over. Exact reset attribution is pending the separate Item-2 tool and is not claimed here.
